condition_1.name: Hourly Close > Daily Open
condition_1.description: Checks if the latest hourly close is above today's open price

condition_2.name: Hourly Close > ([-1] Daily Close * 0.95)
condition_2.description: Checks if the hourly close is above 95% of previous day's close (not down > 5%)

condition_3.name: Hourly Close >= [-10] Daily Close
condition_3.description: Checks if the hourly close is above or equal to the daily close 10 days ago

condition_4.name: 1day RSI(14) > ([-1] 1day RSI(14) + 10)
condition_4.description: Checks if today's daily RSI(14) is more than 10 points higher than yesterday's RSI

condition_5.name: Daily Volume > 5,000,000
condition_5.description: Checks if today's cumulative daily volume exceeds 5,000,000 shares
